label: Repeated interaction (folk theorem)
text: EC.O.A3.5 Repeated interaction — folk theorem: in an infinitely repeated game with a discount factor close enough to one, any feasible, strictly individually rational payoff is sustainable in equilibrium (with a full-dimensionality condition for more than two players). Theorem MA; use in collusion or cooperation EC; choice of game ST.

warrant.standard: theorem plus experimental or comparative evidence
warrant.defeaters: hypotheses not met in the field
